title: Mullin's root-of-unity conjecture for uniform mixing
statement: Let $X$ be a graph, and suppose that $X$ admits uniform mixing at time $t$. **Mullin's conjecture.** Then $e^{it}$ is a root of unity. This conjecture concerns an arithmetic constraint on potential uniform-mixing times; the source gives no resolution, so its status remains open.
source_name: Xiwang Cao and Cuiwen Zhu, “Uniform mixing and ε-uniform mixing on cycles”, arXiv:2607.04207 (2026).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04207

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of July 2026).
